verdict.rationale: Dagster's asset-based model supports partitioned backfills and dynamic partition wiping/deletion (dagster-docs-25), and integrations let you materialize or resync a single asset/table without rerunning the whole pipeline (dagster-docs-7, dagster-docs-8). However, there is no dedicated first-party doc specifically describing a 'backfill history for one table' workflow or UI walkthrough, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of this exact use case. missing for 10: explicit backfill-UI documentation for a single asset/table, independent/hands-on evidence of resync workflows, partition-based backfill guide specifics.
